9z.zh: T 方最常由 dgt 摸边，4 次进攻时他在另一侧或远离进攻点。
9z.en: The T side usually has dgt lurking, with him on the other side or away from the hit on 4 attacks.

astralis.zh: Astralis 的 T 方拖后进攻仅占 5%，低于其他队伍的 27%，较少把进攻留到后段。
astralis.en: Astralis' T side uses late hits in just 5% of rounds versus the other teams' 27%, showing less reliance on delayed attacks.

aurora.zh: Aurora 的 T 方有摸边的进攻占 62%，高于其他队伍的 32%；CT 及时回防占 94%，高于其他队伍的 68%，防守支援更常及时到位。
aurora.en: Aurora's T side includes a lurker on 62% of hits versus the other teams' 32%. Its CT side rotates in time in 94% of rounds versus their 68%, more often providing timely support.

b8.zh: T 方拖后进攻占 55%，高于其他队伍的 25%，但先假打再转点仅占 5%，低于其他队伍的 26%。CT 开局前压占 45%，也低于其他队伍的 71%。
b8.en: The T side favors late hits at 55% versus the other teams' 25%, but rarely fakes before the hit: 5% versus their 26%. The CT side also pushes early less often, at 45% versus their 71%.

betboom.zh: BETBOOM 的 T 方分兵进点占 52%，低于其他队伍的 71%，进攻较少采用分兵合击。
betboom.en: BETBOOM's T side splits on 52% of hits versus the other teams' 71%, showing less reliance on split entries.

fut-esports.zh: FUT Esports 的 T 方快攻占 30%，高于其他队伍的 14%。CT 默认站位 A2 M2 B1 占 32% 的枪局，胜率 83%。
fut-esports.en: FUT Esports' T side fast-hits in 30% of rounds versus the other teams' 14%. Its default CT setup A2 M2 B1 covers 32% of gun rounds with an 83% win rate.

gamerlegion.zh: GamerLegion 的 T 方拖后进攻占 45%，高于其他队伍的 26%；进攻 A 点占 82%，高于其他队伍的 57%。CT 默认 A2 M1 B2 占 27% 的枪局，胜率 0%。
gamerlegion.en: GamerLegion's T side favors late hits at 45% versus the other teams' 26% and attacks A in 82% of rounds versus their 57%. Its default CT setup A2 M1 B2 covers 27% of gun rounds with a 0% win rate.

legacy.zh: Legacy 的 CT 默认站位 A2 M2 B1 占 30% 的枪局，胜率 83%。

lgcy.zh: LGCY 的 CT 方开局前压占 47%，低于其他队伍的 70%。默认站位 A2 M2 B1 占 25% 的枪局，胜率 62%，防守较少向前展开。

liquid.zh: Liquid 的 T 方先假打再转点占 46%，高于其他队伍的 24%。CT 默认站位 A2 M2 B1 占 26% 的枪局，胜率 70%。

mibr.en: MIBR's T side favors an A execute with Mini smoke, Hut roof molotov and Mini-side A site molotov, winning 1 of 4 attempts. The default CT setup A3 M1 B1 covers 34% of gun rounds with a 73% win rate.

monte.en: Monte's go-to T execute hits A with Mini smoke, a Hut roof molotov and a Mini-side A site molotov, winning 3 of 5 attempts. Its CT side pushes early in 50% of rounds versus the other teams' 71%.
